text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the 2nd UGE.
Summoned by Dr. Reitz, we all headed to the lab, and—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are. What took you so long?
choice_data_list: Huh? I'm pretty sure I'm right on time, though?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Was that how it was?
Well, whatever. Such trivialities matter not.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, come on, hurry inside.
Everyone, get in quickly and line up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what?
Why are they so hyped up...?"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*. Today, before we begin the 'Upgrade Exam,'
there is something I want everyone to see.
And that is—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: It's the reborn ST-2!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What?! Reincarnation—you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmm, reborn...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. In addition to a software overhaul,
we decided to make some minor modifications
to the chassis as well.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I really want you to see the newborn ST-2.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it! Please do show me.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Right? Isn't that right?
Now then, it's finally time for the unveiling.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: This is the newly reborn ST-2!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I let out a gasp at its unmistakable transformation.
I couldn't take my eyes off its newly refined body.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is the direction for aerodynamics, huh.
One look at the form and it's pretty clear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Splendid! You've made significant changes to the head part. The weight distribution there is... extremely important, yes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, there has been a clear change.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is also thanks to Hayahide, Taishin,
and Trainer lending a hand
at the Mecha Expo.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I poured in all the knowledge I gained back then.
I won't let it go to waste.
choice_data_list: I see. I'm glad I could be of help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If my assistance back then helped ST-2 grow even further,
nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that the unveiling is done,
let's head over to the venue.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Then let's get right into the test.
I'm counting on you again this time, <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Don't think I'm the same as the previous ST-2.
Make sure you take me seriously.
